gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-123.835493 46.188544)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-123.835493, 46.188544), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
aspect_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Aspect(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast, 
        ST_Buffer(p.geom::geometry, 100), -- buffer to capture surrounding terrain
        TRUE
      ),
      1
    ) AS aspect_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    poi_geom p
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      r.rast, 
      ST_Buffer(p.geom::geometry, 100)
    )
)
SELECT 
  degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Buffer(p.geom::geometry, 100)), 1), ST_PointN(ST_ExteriorRing(ST_Buffer(p.geom::geometry, 100)), 2))) AS bearing
FROM 
  poi_geom p;
